payload.note: Inhomogeneous-twist gauge obstruction: for every periodic site chi, r^(theta+dchi)(psi)=r^theta(psi+chi) and translation of the mean-zero carrier gives Z[theta+dchi]=Z[theta]. Hence the free-energy response Hessian obeys R_theta d=0 and d^*R_theta=0: every longitudinal twist direction is exactly null. A nonzero uniform twist has nonzero torus period and lies in the harmonic/topological sector, explaining why its positive L6/L8 response cannot transfer to scalar Witten or H^-1 coercivity. The twist route is closed for the scalar continuum gate; the live target is the sourced generating functional, equivalently the conditioned-center or full-Witten Schur problem. H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
